verdict.rationale: First-party material names an official Codex SDK for automating coding tasks, including CI jobs (chatgpt-docs-91), so an official SDK exists. The evidence is only a single brief mention, with no detail on languages, API surface, or reference docs, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: SDK language coverage, SDK reference documentation or API surface details, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
